scope: Independent review of literal ordinary API requests and their raw responses. No product edit, build, node, test, or helper execution by this reviewer.
request_review_notes: The declarations use the isolated ordinary schema setup route. Nullable peer-key fields use Any; the addressed key fields remain String.
Hash and HashRange requests clear an optional peer key, then read the source value and the old peer key.
The collision requests give a later source the same peer key and equal payload. Delete, Purge, and a key move from the earlier source must preserve the later peer fields.
The appended exact reads cover both the moved source and its new peer key for Hash and HashRange.
The dependent write batch covers a repeated effective Hash key with an ignored range coordinate and a move through another schema. New peer keys must expose P2; old peer keys must return no records.
The mapped declarations preserve canonical field descriptions and types. Explicit field mappers select the intended shared molecules for the query cases.
limits: Request review does not prove the runtime result.
The small ordinary operation set does not support a latency or throughput conclusion.
Conflicting per-field peer states use the documented conservative cleanup rule; this review does not assume exclusive peer-key ownership.
